beldum.description: Charged stones draw this steel-bodied family to the mountain pass.

trapinch.description: Shifting sand and warm quarry stones shelter this patient desert family.

larvitar.description: Small burrows beneath the crags reveal a family that grows strong on mountain minerals.

bagon.description: A determined mountain family dreams of soaring above the exposed summit.

gible.description: Warm stone hollows shelter a swift family of land-dwelling dragons.

deino.description: Distant calls echo from the shadowy stone passages of the old ruins.

goomy.description: This gentle family follows damp woodland trails beside the brook.

dreepy.description: Faint ghostly shapes gather over the moonlit water after dusk.

frigibax.description: Cold sanctuary stones shelter a resilient family of ice-clad dragons.

jangmoo.description: The ringing of protective scales carries across the high mountain trail.
